summary: Iteration 112 — Full-stack verification of the Individual Journey Certificate + Continue-at-Step, Court Ordered half-size arrows + N-of-4 badges, Child Needs page reorder (Communication-Builder layout + per-tab founder picture + progress-at-end), and the new optional Medical Preventive Care textarea. Backend 7/7 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter112_journey_cert_and_med_preventive.py; regression /app/backend/tests/test_child_needs.py 5/5 passed. Frontend verified live against parent1@test.com and journey6@test.com on the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: journey_summary_routes._missing_steps uses the live counts (BIFF-authored >1, PP completed_at not null, child-needs completed_at for all 3) so the certificate gate matches the UI 6-of-6 banner — single source of truth.

journey_certificate_pdf.build_certificate_pdf uses orientation='L', format='Letter' and a single add_page() → one landscape Letter page as required; honest note explicitly includes 'not a court-approved parenting course certificate and not legal advice' (verified by pypdf text extraction).

CertificateButton closes the dialog only on successful 200 response (setOpen(false) is inside the try after the download), and the button is disabled while busy or when name is empty — clean UX guard against double-submit.

FlowArrow size='sm' used in court/CourtJourneyCards gives the half-size (54–74px) glowing green arrow with the 'N of 4' badge that flips to purple+check via data-done binding to card status — DRY reuse of the Self Journey arrow.

ChildNeedsView loads NEEDS_PAGE_ART[activeKey] on every render; jumpToFields correctly looks up #cn-work [data-field=<id>] and toggles .cn-field-flash with 1800ms timeout — verified live for med_preventive.

child_needs_content.json medical group now carries 7 fields with med_preventive as an optional textarea; backend file equals frontend/src/pages/portal/childNeedsContent.json (byte-identical when parsed).
test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! (partial progress), journey6@test.com / TestPass123! (all 6 done, name 'Jordan Six'). Re-ran seed_journey_six.py twice to reset.
seed_data_creation: A couple of TEST_i112_* fresh users were created during pytest for steps-celebrated flow and medical-draft/submit persistence; no modification to parent1 or journey6 state. Final `cd /app/backend && python seed_journey_six.py` executed as spec requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests use /api/auth/login (not register) for the two seeded accounts and /api/auth/register for TEST_i112_* fresh users. The certificate endpoint returns a landscape 792x612pt Letter PDF (verified via pypdf.PageObject.mediabox); the honest-note line wraps across 'legal\nadvice' in extracted text, so collapse whitespace before asserting. Child-needs state shape: drafts.<cat> is a FLAT answers dict (NOT {answers: {...}}), while committed answers live at answers.<cat>. Court arrow click: use page.evaluate('[...].click()') because .sa-arrow-nudge CSS animation makes element 'not stable' for Playwright's auto-wait. The Child Needs page uses JourneyPage (fixed inset-0 z-50 portal) with the picture in `order-first` and chat in `order-last` divs, giving the mobile reorder picture→portal_bar→form→progress→chat automatically.
rca of the issue: N/A — all tested behaviour matches spec. The 3 initial pytest failures were test-script issues (missing /api/child-needs/content endpoint, wrong draft shape assumption, and PDF line-wrap on 'legal advice') — all fixed inside the test file, not the app code.
